# Final: OpenID Connect Core 1.0 incorporating errata set 2

0 is a simple identity layer on top of the OAuth 2. It enables Clients to verify the identity of the End-User based on the authentication performed by an Authorization Server, as well as to obtain basic profile information about the End-User in an interoperable and REST-like manner. This specification defines the core OpenID Connect functionality: authentication built on top of OAuth 2.
